segments.text: My initial proposal is to launch on Monday with PDF export.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: I agree with Monday and PDF for now, provided the offline test passes.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: The offline test failed. We need to revise both choices.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Then I propose Friday instead, and Markdown export because that already works without an external service.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: Agreed. Friday replaces Monday, and Markdown replaces PDF. These are the final decisions.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: I will run the offline test again on Wednesday. We did not set a calendar date for Friday.
